ios.desc:
xoFocus is an AI-powered highlighter that helps you focus on what matters.

xoFocus instantly identifies key sentences on pages you're reading - so you can quickly grasp core ideas, stay focused, and read more intentionally.
Designed for readers, students, journalists, researchers, and anyone who wants more focus at their fingertips. 

Features:
•Smart Highlights: xoFocus uses AI to highlight the most context-relevant sentences on any text-heavy page.
•Smart Navigation: Quickly skip forward/backward through highlights with simple screen taps.

How It Works:
Enable xoFocus in Safari.
When you open a webpage, highlight animations load instantly.
Double-tap the top or bottom of your screen to move between highlights.

xoFocus helps you cut through the noise: no AI-generated summaries, no logins, no tracking. Just an enhanced reading experience.
